text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more Sakura Chiyono O ran in training 
and races, the more a sense of discomfort 
within herself grew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It almost felt as though the physical 
vessel known as "Sakura Chiyono O" was 
gradually crumbling away, piece by piece—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running any further would mean confronting 
the reality that her peak had already 
passed. Yet, she still couldn't bring 
herself to face it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Maruzensky reportedly won a 
mock race by 7 lengths after a long 
absence. The media was in an absolute 
frenzy, buzzing that the day of the 
legend's revival had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her idol is trying to keep her promise for 
her own sake too. Then... she just has to 
give it her all. Sakura Chiyono O's summer 
training camp begins.
